title.narrative: Partnership for Transforming Health Systems 2 - Procurement of Services

description.narrative: This activity Partnership for Transforming Health Systems 2 - Procurement of Services is a component of Partnership for Transforming Health Systems 2 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £129,783,220. It works in the following sector(s): Health policy and administrative management, Health education, Democratic participation and civil society, Reproductive health care, Public finance management (PFM), Health personnel development, Basic health care, Infectious disease control.
